bull_bear.body:
- "De-risked & robust balance sheet": refinanced debt and healthy internal accruals giving a "moderate leverage ratio of ~2X Debt/EBITDA".
- Debt reduction of ~75% from a peak-debt obligation of ~₹700 Crores, including the corporate guarantee from Wanbury Limited to Wanbury Holding B.V. (Netherlands) for foreign debt held by the Netherlands subsidiary.
- Deleveraging history: strategic sale of brands to Cipla worth ₹87 crore (2020), ₹50 crore capital infusion via preferential issue (2021), ₹95 crore raised via NCD from Neo AIF plus settlement with all lenders (2023), and refinancing of the Neo AIF debt at a lower interest rate (2025).
- FY26 balance sheet: long term borrowings ₹147.15 Crore and short term borrowings ₹68.30 Crore (versus ₹160.29 Crore and ₹12.94 Crore in FY25); other equity turned positive from -₹39.96 Crore in FY23 to ₹109.51 Crore in FY26.
- Shareholding pattern as of 31st March 2026: Promoters 43.08%, Public 56.20%, FIIs + DIIs 0.72%.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Dual revenue-stream company: API 88% and Formulations 12% of FY26 revenue, with total FY26 revenue of ₹650 Crore (API ₹574 Crore, Formulations ₹76 Crore).
- "Global market leaderships in key products" — globally significant market share in Metformin and Sertraline; estimated market share ~10% of a ~75,000 MT global Metformin market, ~30% of a ~680 MT Sertraline market and ~11% of a ~550 MT Tramadol market (Clarivate & Company Estimates).
- Developed/regulated-market focus: exporting to 50+ countries across 4+ continents, with 80%+ of top line from exports and a total revenue mix of 80% exports / 20% domestic; EU, Brazil and US named as target regulatory markets.
- 37+ years of operating history, 1,200+ employee strength, two USFDA-approved API facilities; API portfolio of 6 products described as "100% chronic portfolio" and formulations as 10+ brands, acute & semi-chronic (the Formulations section states "100% Acute Therapy").
- Executive summary frames the story as "Operational & financial turnaround over last 3 years, now transforming into growth momentum".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Regulatory] 70 total DMF/CEP filings approved across geographies — USA 21, Europe 8 approved (1 pending), Brazil 1 approved (5 pending), South Korea 3, ROW 31; approvals include US-FDA since 2000 (last inspection 2024), EDQM since 2007, ANVISA since 2024, KFDA since 2012 (last inspection 2026), COFEPRIS since 2013 and WHO GMP since 2007.
- [Compliance track record] 6th successful USFDA inspection for the Patalganga plant with zero 483 observations (2025), successful ANVISA audit clearance for the Tanuku plant, and management notes "Clearing the MFDS, Korea inspection with zero observations validates our compliance systems".
- [External shock] Management states "The fourth quarter saw a revenue decline due to the West Asia crisis impacting API export dispatches in March".
- [Corporate history] Incorporated as Pearl Organics Pvt. Ltd. in 1990; acquired Wander Limited (a Sandoz subsidiary) in 1995, merged and renamed Wanbury Limited in 2004; acquired DOCL (Tanuku, USFDA-approved) in 2006; listed on NSE & BSE and acquired Cantabria Pharma S.L. (Spain) in 2007; underwent Corporate Debt Restructuring with banks.
- [R&D footprint] API R&D centre at Tanuku, Andhra Pradesh and formulations R&D centre at Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, both DSIR and FDA (India) recognized.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Wanbury as a turned-around, export-led pharmaceutical company with a niche regulated-market API business (globally significant share in Metformin and Sertraline) plus a smaller legacy branded formulations franchise in India being rebuilt, now pivoting from balance-sheet repair to growth via new molecule launches.
